title: Gleater — Smart Fridge Retail
description: Next.js app behind client Pellegrini's smart fridges: QR-based unlock and checkout, plus a companion web storefront for office meal delivery, shipped to iOS and Android with Capacitor. I keep the Node.js/Next.js stack and the GitHub Actions pipeline current, and ship features with Claude Code in a test-first loop.

title: davide.fedele.dev
description: This site: a statically exported Next.js site on Cloudflare Pages with a Three.js hero computer, an interactive terminal, and a contact form handled by a Cloudflare Worker with Turnstile verification. Built with Claude Code.

title: Real-Time Telemetry Dashboard
description: Frontend for pharmaceutical client Alfasigma's production telemetry: state management moved from useEffect chains to Recoil selectors for REST API polling, with Recharts-based analytics views.

title: BigFix UI Component Library
description: Reusable React component library on top of MUI, built with a US-based team for HCL's BigFix, plus features across micro-frontends integrated via Module Federation.

title: Customer Journey & Internal Portals
description: At NTT DATA: key components for an online course customer journey with a full Jest, React Testing Library and Protractor test suite, and an internal legal consulting portal with complex data tables and multi-page forms.

title: Association Management System Rewrite
description: Freelance, solo: rebuilt the frontend of a private client's internal management system from scratch, replacing a legacy Angular UI with Vue 3, Vite and Tailwind CSS.
